author: "McKayla Ford"
date: "2026-08-10"
output: html_document
---

```{r}
file_str <- "rosalind_rna.txt"
DNA_str <- readr::read_file(file_str)
```

```{r}
library(stringr)
```

```{r}
RNA_str <- DNA_str |> str_replace_all("T", "U")
```


```{r}
cat(RNA_str, file = "output.txt")
```
